audience.en: A 27-year-old registered nurse in Da Nang, Vietnam, with a 4-year bachelor's degree, 3 years on a hospital ward and German at A2, comparing routes to a nursing job in Germany: costs, recognition, visa, language and a first-year budget.
audience.vi: Một điều dưỡng 27 tuổi ở Đà Nẵng, Việt Nam, có bằng cử nhân 4 năm, 3 năm làm ở khoa bệnh viện và tiếng Đức trình độ A2, đang so sánh các con đường để làm điều dưỡng ở Đức: chi phí, công nhận bằng, thị thực, ngôn ngữ và ngân sách năm đầu.

localeReason: English and Vietnamese both serve this decision. The person is a Vietnamese nurse in Da Nang weighing recruitment routes, agency fees and a first-year budget, and Vietnamese lets them read the fee caps, warning signs and open questions in their own language; it changes no rule, fee or eligibility.

planningAssumptions.profile: 27-year-old registered nurse in Da Nang, 4-year bachelor’s degree, 3 years on a ward, German A2 in November 2026; childless, tax class I.
planningAssumptions.route: Employer-pays direct or seal-holding agency route; not Triple Win (Vietnam not a current partner country).
planningAssumptions.timeline: A2 to B1 by March 2027, B2 by autumn 2027, arrival December 2027 – February 2028; planning assumptions, not official.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Local files only. The README locale contract and VOICE-GUIDE were read first, then the run’s index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md (and the worker notes only for exact Goethe and LfP URLs). No network research, build or publication during authoring. The Vietnamese page was translated from the English guide.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: The original research used plain HTTP plus a managed browser with a persistent profile, not a verified clean session. Make it in Germany, thuvienphapluat.vn, the auswaertiges-amt.de district page and the DOLAB site were blocked and not bypassed; the VKA tariff PDF returned an HTML page. Embassy, Goethe, LfP and WHO items were read by workers; the independent check did not reopen them.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: The independent Decimal recomputation matched every money figure after small corrections: Leipzig taxable income 28,671 (was 28,672), Leipzig net pay 25,395.60 (was 25,395.61), Leipzig left after year 1 11,887.26 (was 11,887.27), VND 332,843,280 (was 332,843,560), and the pre-departure subtotal 1,560.02 (an earlier text said about 1,260). The run’s index.html already shows the corrected values and this guide follows them. The check left six issues open (see uncertainties).
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: The run’s own layout check used headless Chrome at 1280 px; a true 390 px reflow was not verified, and no build, browser or visual check was done for these Markdown files.

datePolicy: All sources were read on 2026-11-08 in the original run and that access date is kept; document and listing dates are separate and stated in the guide. Tariff table validity (1 May 2026 – 31 March 2027) is a source date, not an access date. Copy editing and translation are not a refresh.
uncertainties: TVöD-P pay figures rest on two agreeing secondary tariff sites; the primary VKA tariff PDF was not re-opened. The table expires on 31 March 2027, so 2027/28 pay will differ.

Make it in Germany, thuvienphapluat.vn, the auswaertiges-amt.de consular-district page and the DOLAB site were blocked; the Da Nang consular district, the VFS fee, the §81a fee (a €411 figure online is unconfirmed), Decree 112/2021, the DOLAB licence list and the telc/ÖSD accepted-provider list were not obtained.
No official statement was found on whether a Vietnamese Bachelor of Nursing is equivalent to German nursing training; the timeline and B2 by autumn 2027 are assumptions.

Vietnam’s Law 69/2020 fee cap (1 month’s pay per 12 months, 3 months for contracts of 36 months or more, brokerage ban, blocked-account deposit) was read only on a mirror site; whether it applies to a German agency is undetermined.

Triple Win: the Vietnam strand found was a 2021 trainee programme; absence of a current Vietnam programme is worded as “found”, not proven. The Vietnam not on the WHO list finding and its link to BeschV §38 are partly inference; the 2026 WHO list is provisional.

Tax and cost lines: the €1,230 and €36 lump sums, food, phone, flight, translations, clothes, household start, the Stuttgart deposit, the broadcast fee €18.36 and the Deutschlandticket €63 are assumptions or unverified; annual special payment excluded; real payroll tax may differ by tens of euros a year.
Rent examples are single advertiser listings (rooms, not flats), possibly already let; the Plieningen posting date is not shown.

Embassy, Goethe, LfP and WHO items were read by workers; the independent check did not reopen them; the BA’s “B1 = hinreichend” is unconfirmed; Bavaria is the only state checked for B2 and recognition fees.
